inputs.research_goal: Required end-to-end research objective for the run.
inputs.seed_query: Optional seed search query for the first research round.
inputs.seed_urls: Optional list of seed URLs for the first research round.
inputs.max_depth: Required maximum depth for this run.
inputs.max_rounds: Required maximum research-round budget for this run.
inputs.output_root: Optional root directory for ledgers, materials, UI artifacts, and reports.
inputs.evidence_policy: Required policy describing what evidence and materials must be preserved.
inputs.demo_mode: Optional flag that enables process-demo reporting.
inputs.user_language: Optional user language preference for review surfaces and report output.
inputs.intake_comments: Optional native-language freeform intake comments captured as first-class workflow input.

default_assumptions.ledger_artifacts: Create and maintain data/, notes/, materials/, ui/, qa-pairs.txt, error-handling.txt, and report artifacts before the first substantive research action.
default_assumptions.round_contract: Each research round records trigger, working hypothesis, chosen action, evidence gathered, and next-step decision.
default_assumptions.action_classes: The workflow starts with abstract action classes such as search, dig, compare, fact-check, and summarize rather than hard-binding to one toolchain.
default_assumptions.material_review_rule: After bounded research, assemble a full material inventory and present it to the user before report drafting.
default_assumptions.freeform_input_rule: Every ask-user checkpoint and every UI form must include native-language freeform input, and that input is first-class workflow input.
default_assumptions.evidence_creation_boundary: Only the research loop may create new evidence; cherry-pick and draft-review loops work on existing evidence plus user comments.
default_assumptions.draft_review_boundary: Draft review evaluates the written report draft, not the raw material inventory.

outputs.material_inventory: Reviewable inventory of gathered sources, excerpts, screenshots, and provenance.
outputs.round_ledger: Structured trail of round-by-round decisions and evidence capture.
outputs.continuation_payload: Structured payload that merges user selections and freeform native-language comments for the next workflow step.
outputs.report_draft: Draft report with conclusion, scope, round history, evidence chain, cited sources, unresolved questions, and review summaries.
outputs.final_report: Final Markdown report after user finalization.
